caveats.long_context: Input strictly greater than 272000 tokens on one request doubles all input/cache rates and multiplies output by 1.5 for that entire request.
caveats.cache_write: The flat reference cache_write rate is for 30-minute retention. The separate 12-hour write rate is twice this rate and is not inferred from logs.
caveats.regional: Regional processing and FedRAMP premiums are not inferred. The official pricing page lists 10% uplifts; apply only when independently known.
caveats.gpt-5.6-sol: Promotional pricing is stated as available at least through 2026-11-21. This is not a confirmed end date and no later price is assumed.
caveats.tier: default means Standard; priority is the documented alias of Fast. Missing tier uses Standard as a reference assumption, not a verified account default. auto/scale and unlisted model-tier combinations cannot be priced.
caveats.scope: Token-only API reference estimate, not a bill, subscription debit, provider quote, or historical rate reconstruction. Tool fees and exchange-rate conversions are excluded. Runtime never refreshes this snapshot online.
